style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF and matte light-grey #F2F2F2 studio panels for packshots, craft and info screens; grey asphalt street ground #8F8F8F with yellow-black accent posts for worn lifestyle shots

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent street-style kids-fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, matte light-grey #F2F2F2, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one street-yellow accent #FFD400, with an electric-blue secondary accent #2F4BD8 reserved for chip labels only; neutral tone; bright even high-key studio light with a soft front-left key and soft contact shadows for studio shots, and bright 5500K midday daylight with a crisp directional shadow on #8F8F8F asphalt for street shots; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only with bold condensed section words; consistent thin-line icons and small rounded chip labels; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the top and the shorts always presented together as one two-piece set; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale on worn shots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no splitting the two-piece set into mismatched garments
style.presentationRules: the top and the shorts are always presented together as one two-piece set, never split or swapped; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale on worn shots; stable front and overhead angles on flat-lay shots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white paper #FFFFFF, matte light-grey studio board #F2F2F2, brushed grey asphalt #8F8F8F
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; bold condensed section words paired with a short sub-line; no mixing of serif, handwritten or retro faces
